title: Investigating Monogenity in a Family of Cyclic Sextic Fields
content:
Jones \cite{jones}  characterized among others monogenity of a family 
of cyclic sextic polynomials. Our purpose is to study monogenity of the family
of corresponding sextic number fields. This also provides the first 
non-trivial application of the method described in \cite{totrelext},
emphasizing its efficiency.
